as_told.title: Green fireball seen with Lue Elizondo in Wyoming

plain: Michels says that one night in 2024, while visiting the Wyoming home of Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official and author of the book Imminent, he and his crew saw a green orb in the sky alongside Elizondo. Michels tells it as his own sighting, reminding Elizondo of it on camera. Telling it again a few months later to another guest, he describes it as a green fireball that shot out into the sky.
